english.title: Conspire to submit controlled waste to a listed operation without an environmental permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to submit controlled waste, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WASTE..), to a listed operation carried out

(E)_[in or on land at **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..)]_
(F)_[by means of mobile plant, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLANT..), situated at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)]_

except under and in accordance with an environmental permit
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1)(b), (6) and (8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
